text: Iced Chai was delicious and just what I needed on this beautiful day. After getting to the store next door and realizing I left my sunglasses somewhere and of course I retraced my steps. They led me back to The coffee shop. Imagine my surprise when I walk and and the barista is wearing my Ray Bans and asking her counter part if they look good on her. I walk in ask if I left my Ray Bans and sheepishly her coworker hands them over. Pretty sad to think they wouldn't have at least put them in lost and found for a few hours let alone minutes... :( sad because I am "that girl" who never has her things put in lost and found. Happy I walked in at the right moment and got them back:)
I love the quinoa and kale bowl and the edamame and hummus sandwich. Both are super delicious and I have a hard time ordering anything different, which I am sure everything is just as delicious.

Avoid the regular sandwich bread.. it's super dry.

Lilac is our absolute favorite gluten free bakery. The only item we haven't liked was the breakfast sandwich. The bread was so incredibly dry... like cardboard. :-(

We were surprised because all their other pastries are so amazingly soft and wonderful. 

Tasty lattes and fun atmosphere when you sit streetside.

I came here for dinner and wish I had looked at Yelp before landing here.  I sat at the bar and the service managed to squeak by to pass, but barely.

I ordered crab cakes, average at best, and the mussels and clams, rubbery!  Wish I had spent my time, calories and money on something much better.  I wouldn't recommend the place and won't return.
Love the Avocado Toast. Took train to Santa Barbara at earlier morning. Goat Tree is the one restaurant start 7:00am. Feel perfect get hot food after walked pier.

Unfortunately my visit with friends and family was not positive. Young staff not aware of Groupon deal. Staff reflected rude attitude when they did not understand the offer. No manager present for guidance, no reply from manager or owners regarding matter. Staff needs customer service training.

Let me start by saying - I LOVE CUPCAKES. They are my guilty pleasure, so I've had a LOT of them. These are by far the BEST I have ever had .... Always fresh, moist, and totally delish! My favorites are the crumb and vanilla bean. Its a good thing I don't live in SB or I would be here probably every other day! But I definitely make a stop here every time I am in town :)
I love SB Roasting. They have great coffee, food, and service. Plus their internet works well, which seems kind of rare at local coffee shops sometimes.

Began my vegan journey early this year. So I thought I would help the world with my input through my adventures of eating out and all that jazz. Be easy.. I am new to this. I got a smoothie and a chia bread slice which was pretty good. My friends who are non vegan (boohoooooo) ordered non vegan things, they weren't  sure about the sizing on a few things but the flavors were there. I could not put 5 stars only because the girl with currls had a fit and cussed her way to the back of the building assuming she's the chef, not cool! The boy upfront with dreads was cool, though conversation was limited. So long SB!
Best coffee in town! You can order online or inside and they have nice little place inside you can have your coffee and grab carrot cake or danish

Here in SB from Portland OR for a girls' weekend. Walked here from Best Western hotel. What a find!!! Amazing food, great prices and totally awesome service. Coming back tomorrow for their package deal of gallon o' coffee and and muffins to have around the pool! Generous portions, fresh juices and smoothies. Lovely shaded outdoor seating.
Genuinely good coffee and the best I've had in a while. Nice people and great place to relax.

I always go here every time I head to Santa Barbara and would grab a quick bite and coffee break. I always enjoyed the ambience because it's so cute, relaxing and quaint. Ideally, I want give this place 4 stars. But over time, I started to notice that some things are lacking and it's become just decent. 

There have been times when their baked goods and desserts were scrumptious while other times, they were just bad and dry with no taste at all. My most recent visit, I had ordered a chocolate cookie that tasted like uncooked dough and I couldn't really taste any chocolate in it. I also ordered smoked salmon plate with bagels and it was very ordinary. The smoked salmon wasn't fresh and bagels were very dry and stale. Even the chicken pesto sandwich was just decent and nothing special. 

Lately, service has been subpar. There were times when I would get a very nice staff worker when I ordered my food. But recently, I would get some that weren't very courteous and unfriendly or even crack a smile. 

All in all, I will still come here for a quick food break just because I enjoy the setting and it's on my way. But, now my expectations have changed and not what it used to be.

I absoluely LOVE natural cafe!  It is clean, quick and inexpensive.  The gobler burger is one of my favorite things from any restaurant.  It always feels good to eat somewhere with REAL ingredients.  Nice outdoor seating too!  I love this place!

Thanks to the helpful staff for the venue choice for my mother in laws memorial. Catering service was great and helpful. The food was warm and great tasting. Didn't know the venue existed and looking forward to trying out Breakfast and lunch menu in near future!
I like the avocado toast here with seasonal fruits aside. Very nice place to have a breakfast.
Breakfast Lunch or Dinner. Get you buns down here and order ANYTHING. If you are on a diet don't go near the pastry displays!
Food is good and fresh, as is coffee, but the service is really slow. Not the servers fault but only ever one person behind the counter.

I have loved the Blue Owl since it opened and Im so glad that I can receive their delicious and creative dishes by delivery ( through Grubhub). Open late enough to stop by for a late night bite downtown or an afternoon late lunch the Blue Owl has fresh and delicious, interesting food. My favorite it the beet/ pistachio salad.

I live two blocks from Daily Grind and I eat it at least every two weeks, sometimes every week. The breakfast burritos are really good, I like the chorizo burrito or sometimes if I don't feel like getting meat, I'll sub avocado for the meat which is really good. The salsa isn't like one I've ever had and has an interesting flavor but I like it. 

I've had the tuna melt, tuna sandwich, and the 2001 turkey sandwich and they are all great. The sandwiches come with a side of tortilla chips. I've had the open faced lox bagel sandwich which was good but very messy (most open faced sandwiches are). 

They have delicious coffee drinks and a lot of different smoothies. Great bagels. I haven't tried any pastries but I have heard good things. 

It is always very busy so sometimes I'll just order over the phone for pickup but when I don't do that, the line always moves very quickly. There are lots of small tables inside and outside. Great environment and food/drinks.

I love this place! I come here almost every other day to study and get an exceptional cup of coffee. The service is fantastic, and the coffee is consistently great. I usually get a Gibraltar, but their espresso (I get short pull) is really tasty! Really recommend it!

We were down in Santa Barbara for Memorial Day weekend and were so happy to find this hidden gem. Lokum is an absolutely beautiful store that sells homemade Turkish delights, the widest assortment of baklava I have ever seen, pomegranate herbal teas, etc.

The owner and employees are very friendly and helpful. They greeted us and offered us free samples as soon as we walked into the store. They also explained they can ship their products to you if you are from out of town and cannot bring the treats back easily.

I highly recommend checking out Lokum if you are in Santa Barbara!

HUGE FAN.  I currently live in Chicago, and do not let a visit go by in CA without coming up to SB and grabbing some good yums at the Natural.

I came upon it a few years ago when I lived down the street, and made it a frequent stop before I moved.  I used to bring my books and study for hours, and no one ever bothered me.  Now, I think I have dragged all of my non local friends to this place at least once.  

I have only been to two of the locations (State St and the one in San Luis Obispo), but I would like to eventually check out the others.

Highly recommend the veg chili with corn bread (had this like 3 weeks ago), the kids pb and honey sandwich, grilled chicken pita, roasted turkey sand, and last but never the least, the peanut butter vanilla shake.  To die for.

we came here with a big wedding party the day after our wedding. we called a few weeks prior to see if the casual seating would work out and were assured it would. having said that, the service was absolutely terrible. every staff member was rude, and treated everyone with disrespect. the food was incredible, I do have to give them that, but we were really disappointed with how this place treats customers. we were sitting at our tables all spread out and the servers/bussers kept trying to clear our tables to rush us out and said "we are busy and need you to hurry up". I have more specific examples of our experience here if anyone is interested. I work in customer service and did not appreciate the lack of service Jeannine's offers. we brought in over 40 customers and paid well over $1300 and unfortunately our business was not welcomed. shame on you Jeannine's. I expected better in lovely Santa Barbara.

Stopped by today from our drive from SLO to LA -and I remembered having lunch here a few times in the past so I thought it be a great stop to have a healthy and yet filling lunch. I forget how much I love this place!  Got the Great Greenie juice and a California Dreamin' breakfast burrito (Avo, scrambled eggs, fries and cheddar)- kind of amazing in every way, I mean, fries? Reminds me of my carne asada fries days in San Diego, and yet a graduated more distinguished version. Soo soo good. The place is always clean and the staff is always super friendly and accommodating. Family friendly, clean, quick and easy. A great casual spot for a quick lunch with quality and fresh ingredients. I'm a fan.

Her salad was good, but nothing special my wife said.  I had the pasta special and it was rather bland -- shredded cheese straight from a pack, creamy sauce.  Living with a vegetarian, there are a lot of ways to "make it up" (fresh garlic, fresh herbs, grated cheese, pepper flakes, etc.) -- none of those "tricks" made it in my special.
It might be more a lunch place than dinner -- the ambiance was more cafeteria than dining.  We'll may go back, but for lunch.
As a vegetarian, my wife would rate one star above my 2 because there are a lot choices.

The food was good. I had a french toast and the american breakfast with a baguette.

The only thing that disappointed me was the I had an access card deal for buy 1 get 1 free meal. The cashier only took half off of one meal and wouldnt reimburse the rest of the cost. It was pretty upsetting because i came in hoping to pay $11 for my meal but ended up paying double. I asked her about it and she said it was be reversed and sent back to my card but i do not see that at all. 

Why would she use a BOGO 50% off when i said I had a BOGO free? I dont know.

I called with a last minute request for a friend's birthday.  I needed something sweet and help with the delivery.  Carol was very accommodating.  She arranged for 2 dozen cupcakes to be packaged and delivered within a few hours.  I highly recommend Delicious Expressions!

If you're looking for a small, local coffee shop with solid options, look no further. I immediately felt at home when I walked through the doors of Santa Barbara Roasting Company. There were students doing homework, locals reading books, and friends catching up over a cup or two of coffee. I ordered the latte and was pleasantly surprised. The size of the cup as well as the quality of the latte were impressive and the relaxed atmosphere was perfect for doing work without feeling like I was in an office space.

In 2019 I visited this place and it was great! It is now June 2021 and I am back in Santa Barbara again! I have eaten two meals at Natural Cafe since I arrived and they were both awesome! I mostly like to cook my own food, but when I don't, I look for places that serve healthy, well made food and this place never disappoints. I am a pescatarian/plant based leaning person. There are options to suit most any dietary preferences or requirement at Natural Cafe.  There is plenty of seating inside and out. And the location is great! Right in the middle of State Street hustle and bustle!

My daughter and I did not have a positive experience. She ordered the salmon benedict.The eggs were very undercooked with slimy runny whites.My frittata was thin, dry and stuck to the skillet it was served in.We also ordered cappaccinos that were served in paper cups and not proper mugs.I also ordered a plain croissant and got a lemon cream infused one.I expect more from a $60.00 breakfast.An hour later we came back for a carrot juice and iced coffee ($15.00).
Twenty minutes later, I was doubled over in pain and glued to the potty.Turns out I got ecoli, maybe from the salad on the frittata?The outside patio seating however is lovely.

Stopping for breakfast in Santa Bárbara? Look no further. This place is amazing! The banana French toast was absolutely delicious! Some of the best breakfast I've had! It's a little pricey, but what isn't in Santa Bárbara? Well worth it!

I had really high expectations for this bakery since I'm a pastry chef myself. They seem like they are going for more of a wholesale bakery rather than retail since the show case was rather sad. We arrived at 10:45 on Sunday but there was no sign of life. We thought they were closed but we asked a chef who was just arriving to work and he said they opened at 11.....kind of odd for a bakery. We had the blueberry hand pie. It was good but probably not worth $6.50.  No espresso drinks but they had drip coffee. We will come back again in the future when they aren't so new.
Great sandwiches. A friend and I wandered in today for lunch and I would definitely go back. Lots of veggies on them!

I legit come here many times a week. It does get very busy dependent on the time you go. The staff there is so nice and welcoming. Any issue I've had with an order is always resolved. I like to come here sometimes just to say hi and see smiling faces. Tyler is my favorite (no shade to the others)! He's always smiles and spreading good vibes. It's nice to get that after being in an office all day! Thanks
The best coffee ever!  What a great way to experience the real Santa Barbara.

Run don't walk to this new establishment. Brought to you by our Seven Hills Turkish friends. Enjoy the best tasty delightful treats and baklava from Turkey cuisine. First day today and I will be back. Giving samples of the Turkish delights and they did not disappoint. Who doesn't love baklava? There are more varieties here than I have ever experienced, from almond to pistachio, chocolate and more. Stop, try some with Turkish coffee, what a great place to experience alone or with friends or family.

I'm not looking for gourmet -- just a well made cupcake, or two. Something to nibble on after lunch over at Carlito's.

For that purpose, Crushcakes totally hits the spot. Normal cupcakes, and mini ones. The few times I've been there, the cupcakes have always been made perfectly, with great texture, moisture, and icing.

I'm debating whether or not two stars are a  generous review. The young lady working the shop was very cold and obviously didn't want to be working. I ordered a soy latte with a shot of peppermint, instead I received something that taste like a wet dog with NO hint of peppermint bath wash.

I wish i could give this place 5 stars but there were a few things I didn't like. 1) they don't substitute their salad with fries, like why not?? 2) they have canned sodas.. everyone knows canned sodas at restaurants are over priced and never enough! 3) our food took forever to come out.. we even seen people who ordered after us get their food before us and last but not least.. parking and seating sucks,  hardly any of both. So with that said.. the food alone deserves the 4 stars. I had the Tijuana.. basically a chicken wrap but it was amazing! My husband had "Just the tip" and that was equally as delicious!

We ordered a burger, tri tip sandwich and a side of fries. The burger was okay. The tri tip sandwich was bland. The fries were oily and soggy. The water cups and ketchup bottles were filthy. I wouldn't recommend going here

This is the best breakfast in SB and by far the best croissant I've had outside of France! When I first discovered this little gem my partner and I went 4 days in a row. It's consistent, the staff is friendly, and the owner is very kind! I feel good supporting this local business and hope to see them grow!

A hip place to hang out.  Lots of people coming in an out.  No public bathroom in building, but there is one in next door's restaurant.
I decided to try something different, Beet Root Latte, looks and tasted great.
Croissant is beautify layered with butter, excellent snack to go with the hot drink.  Feels like I am on a Europe vacation.
So far all the burgers i've tasted are very delicious! Always come here for my burgers and wouldnt trade them. Best burgers in town !

I don't even remember how I found this place, but now whenever I'm in the Funk Zone I crave their food.  If it's before noon I crave the Ranchero Burrito (a great breakfast burrito) or if it's after noon I crave the pre-made sandwiches (heated up to it's toasty goodness) or the burrito bowl (burrito without the tortilla, more like a salad) with either chicken or rajas.  

Lorraine is a cool lady and the other ladies working there are solid.  Good people that it feels good to support.
You can find the almond crescent at Gelson's and if you go at night after 5pm you get 2 of them for the price of one! They taste just as good at the end of the day.

My Daughter is a regular here and loves it, so much so she suggested we go here on Mother's Day while I visited Santa Barbara. 
They were so ill prepared for the volume obviously, we waited forever for our food and it was frozen when it arrived.  I was more disappointed for my Daughter who wanted everything to be special for me. Very sad as she tells me it's usually excellent.

So very, very happy to have a cafe on Milpas other than Mexican food.  We need a variety & this is perfect!  Had coffee & cinnamon roll-yummy.  Good to know we can come here for coffee - sit outside in nice weather & dog friendly.  Breakfast today will either be the Rolex or the oatmeal.  Richie described the oatmeal & it sounds luscious.  Keep up the good work Chris & all the others we need you in the neighborhood......

Family business .... Smiles and a wonderfully delightful scene... Professional and courteous ... Nice and pleasant ... so it is also really close to where I live ... hence an amazing place for a 2 o'clock coffee tradition and one of these days I am going to sit inside because they just expanded la area as business is crushing it....

This was our first time to try the Goat Tree.  The name was cute so thought we'd try it.  A friend and I went for breakfast and used our AXXESS card which gave us a buy one get one free.  I had the chicken and waffles dish which was ok - but the waffle wasn't even hot enough to melt the butter.  My friend ordered the egg  frittata.  AgaIn just ok.  We both ordered Americana coffees and were being surprised when we got our bill to find a 'refill' cost the same as the first cup ($4.50).  Can get much better coffee at Starbucks for less.  Not likely to go back.

Wow.  First off, the staff is SO so ridiculously helpful and friendly.  Second, the breads are amazing! I got a honey oat bun to eat there, and a rosemary olive loaf to take home.  I'm so glad I got one to eat there!  They both are amazing - light but filling.  I wish I lived closer so I could stock up on their bread all the time, but I definitely need a trip back so I can fill my freezer.  I also got a shortbread cookie, and that I found to be too sweet.  But the bread is some of the best gluten free bread I've ever had, and my sense of "too sweet" is maybe a little lower than most.  I will definitely be making a trip back to SB in part just to go here!

Love the chicken fried steak with extra country gravy sauce and the new Big Dipper melt with side of new onion rings is really good, but my review is really about Maranda! She is the best!!!
Miranda is without question the most friendly and helpful staff member at any resturaunt I have ever ordered from. She always remembers my extra sides, even when I forget to ask for them and is very personable.  Denny's is very lucky to have her and should appreciate having her at their establishment!  She brings customers back.
Thank you Maranda, you rock!!!
Rasta
Limited seating. Menu was ok. Not a coffee drinker, so probably why my review is low.

Lovely little place! We had the croque madames that were amazing. My cappuccino was rich and came with a heart in the foam. Just wonderful. The owner is the baker and the cook and his wife is the barrister. They are both from France and it shows in their wonderful food. Great attention to detail. You must go for the lattes, croissants or French lessons if you're interested. Tres manifique.

I just recently tried the amazing almond croissant and it was so fabulous, I wanted to eat it forever. As you can see, all the reviews for this are true and everyone loves them.  If you are visiting Santa Barbara, please go to Renaud's and try the almond croissant ASAP, you'll also need to buy a box for friends,... But you might eat the all!  there are none like this anywhere!!!!
Great healthy and fresh food. Nice people who work there and a pleasant place to eat. Always one of my go to places when visiting SB.

Went there for a macchiato on Monday night before catching train back to LA. They use Verve coffee beans from SantaCruz and was happy that the server explained the different tastes/notes succinctly of the S.O and blend offered for espresso that day. And yep - it was tasty!!

Absolutely no complaints on the food, only gushing compliments. 

You can order from the mains and dine-in menu, but you will not be able to resist a pastry on the side. The croissants are the best in Santa Barbara and we are truly spoiled to have them. Nothing mushy and puffy about them, they are flakey and crisp on the outside, perfect for a quick dip in the cappuccino or some hot chocolate. Just make sure it's good hot chocolate or you will do your croissant a grave disservice. 

They have a great Axxess deal: first use is buy one entree get one free. Purchases afterwards are 10% off.  We used the bogo today for our toasted croissant breakfast sandwich and croque monsieur. So good. Each came with a choice of salad or cup of fruit.  And of course we got a pastry to nibble on while waiting for our hot food.

Macarons are smaller than when they first opened, but they are also now half the price, about 95 cents. I like this new size, it's a perfect little mouthful. 

Customers move in and out in a steady flow. Renaud's is easy to find while the Plaza is undergoing renovations - just watch were all the people in the carpark are walking to.

Hipster Coffee. Handlebars is a cute and trendy atmosphere, but the coffee leaves something to be desired. There are not many options on the menu, and the options offered are nothing to write home about. Also, it's not easy to park.

I will say this, if you are lactose intolerant or dairy sensitive, it is a good option for you as they offer healthy milk alternatives. Latte fans such as myself will be disappointed. I think the best part of going to handlebars is getting to have a trendy coffee-shop-alternative on your Instagram checkins.
Great blended skinny mocha latte, but not so nice barista. She took forever and made a big deal of it. Cute quote signs, art, and vibes. I really liked this cafe!!! It got me caffeinated, too.

Fabulous and hip Santa Barbara coffee shop: includes alley shaded outdoor seating (shared with three pickles next door), modern interior seating, and rich tasting coffee.  I have ordered regular coffee and lattes here, both delicious.  Once in a while I splurge on their 4-5$ vanilla latte because I'm a sucker for their homemade syrup.

My husband and I went to The French Table on "date night" last week and loved it!  
We ordered the proscuitto bruschetta and a bottle of wine to start - both delicious.  Our entree's took some time to come out, but we honestly didn't even notice/care - we almost expected there would be some kinks in the kitchen with it being a newer restaurant; especially on a busy night.  
The manager and our waitress were super apologetic and offered us a second bottle of wine and dessert on the house for the "inconvenience".  (Again, the wait wasn't even really that long.)
When we received our food it was very, very, very good.  I had the beef bourguignon and my husband had the duo boudin; we were really happy with both.  For dessert we got la guillotine - so yummy!!!  
We will definitely dine at The French Table again...  I've already made reservations there for my office holiday luncheon and plan to take some family in for lunch this week as well. Highly recommended.

Vegan donuts are a must try! I was amazed at how great the old fashioned vegan donuts tasted! We tried them all. It's nice to have a place that has multiple vegan options. Thanks for the great experience.

Beware! You will be addicted for life :-) delicious and beautiful Turkish desserts in the heart of Santa Barbara. The service is amazing, David is our favorite. We highly recommend this place for some delights and tea. Also Great for gifts to take back to your loved ones with beautiful presentation. Thank you can't wait to be back!
Great costumer services , good coffee , Carrot Cake   , i didn't try the food but next I visit I will
When you let someone book a table for 25 people and then just straight up don't have a table when we arrive - that's next level.
That does make me feel better. And what about the black nail polish? How does that not get in my food?

I have to admit, the first time I saw the Boochies menu I thought "what the heck is all this? What's up with all these sprouted things?" I was kind of scared. But now that I've tried several of their items, I am honestly hooked!

My favorites so far are the mac n cheese and the carrot bomb, but everything I've had has been really good. I also recommend the kale avocado salad and the matcha lattes.

The food and drinks are amazing but my favorite thing about Boochies is knowing that I can trust Rebekah and her friendly staff to feed me only things that are good for me. I look forward to trying the whole menu!

I usually like French Press but today's coffee drinks we got were pretty bad. Coffee tasted stale and the milk tastes like it went bad. They also have a pastry display that had flies flying inside it landing on each pastry. I told the cashier, who waved one off initially and then after it landed on a couple more pastries, finally decided to kill it. The pastries remained there to be sold to unsuspecting customers.

As with everything in Santa Barbara, it's a bit pricey. However, if you are looking for a delicious almond croissant, do come here. Just expect a good continental breakfast and nothing else.

We made the unfortunate choice of having a full breakfast, and were ignored by the staff unless we got up to ask for simple things like forks and spoons. Breakfast is crafted to a much higher level at other establishments.
Delici.. Friday Saturday and Sunday late night after dt you'll find them open !:) their tritip rice on point !!:)  and it's open late .. !

This place is so so cute! Definitely ig vibes. The only reason this isn't 5 stars is because their drinks are definitely pricey. We got two drinks for $20!  I got the Bella Rosa and Jupiter's Forest. I don't really drink coffee so I gravitated towards he matcha. The rose flavor was there but it was very light. The Jupiter's Forest was good but definitely needed more sugar. Overall the drinks are gorgeous but idk if I can pay $10 for a drink daily.

Excellent and tasty selection of donuts and bagels -- hard to find in one place! Proprietor is kind, thoughtful, and generous. A wonderful spot. Can't believe I drove by it every day for 3 years without stopping. Everyone would be able to find something they like here!

Found out about this place through a yelp event and we like to visit places again to see if they're consistently good. I recommend getting the works or larger, for the classic size was too small and not portioned as well. Consider preordering because they keep it in the freezer and the açaí is firmer. The prices may seem steep but I will say açaí is pretty expensive itself and the toppings you can add are also costly as well. For what you get..it's pretty worth it! The açaí here is smooth and delicious- they have more of a blueberry notes vs most places having a prune notes with the grittiness. The bowls are parfait style as you can see in photos people post.  The ingredient are good here, from the organic granola that stays crispy (so you know it's fresh), to the peanut butter that's surprising good with the açaí (sorry peanut allergy people you can't enjoy it). I recommend this place and they also have an access deal!

I saw this cute half bakery, half boutique store while walking down State street, and I decided to get a snack for one.  They baked the empanada in small batches and they all came to the table hot and fresh.  The classic empanada had a thinner crust while the gourmet empanada had a flaky crust .  The beef filling was perfectly spiced and had moderate amount of rich and savory juice.  Just like eating a Chinese dumpling, If you let it sit for awhile, the juice will reabsorb back into the meat and will not be as delicious.  The side of chimichurri was garlicky and herbaceous.  I will definitely come back to try the other flavors.  I am deducting one star because they forgot about my order.  Maybe they should give each customer a number to streamline the ordering process.  Furthermore, every single person who came in asked about the difference between classic and gourmet.  They should consider adding that information to the menu.

If I could give it 3 1/2 stars I would. 

The hubs and I stopped in here yesterday to get some pastries to go for our car ride home to San Diego. 

The place is very small and has limited seating (some inside and a bit more outside) but overall tiny. 

He got an apricot pastry and I the coconut croissant. He said his was pretty good and I thought mine was decent. I didn't eat mine until 24 hours later so the croissant itself wasn't as soft and flaky but there definitely could have been more filling. 

I have been to France and lived on the French side of Switzerland last summer for over 2 months and have had plenty of pastries in my day...this place was good but nothing amazing and didn't quite live up to the hype on Yelp. I, for one, think the pastries in Europe are much better.

Not sure what the price was for both as the hubs paid for it...

Not impressed. Staff does not pay attention to simple requests. They throw away & waste a ton of food. I will Never invest a single penny of my hard-earned money here. They have 0 outlets to use for charging because they suck. Waste of time, I will remember to avoid this place in the future.

Nice coffee shop with a local vibe.  I really like the lounge area which has big patio doors that open up to the sidewalk.  The coffee is self serve after you pay and get your cup.  They had about 6-7 varieties of coffee!

Great local place for breakfast. Ate here a couple weeks ago while seeing colleges with my daughter. A couple guys running the floor the day we were in. I had huevos rancheros and daughter had french toast. Good and Good.

This place was a great place to go on a saturday night.
Lot's of friendly people. Nice staff!

The patrons didn't even mind our silly bachlorette games.

Over all we had a great experience here.
Perfectly pulled shots, fabulous macchiato! Fast & friendly service!

3.5 stars 

 I used to cross the street during track meets at SBCC to get snacks here. 

Tonight I had dinner here - wasn't expecting a whole lot from a snack shack but the seafood soup and burrito were surprisingly decent and palatable. The soup in particular was a good amount of fresh seafood and very welcome on yet another chilly night in SB.

The Shop Cafe is in a league of its own. Don't let the modest store front fool you this place is a gem.. the menu covers all the bases with breakfast and lunch options that are delicious, affordable, and all made in house (even the burger buns which are out of this world tasty). In a town where there is no shortage of places to eat, The Shop Cafe is without a doubt on top of my list. If you're a local it is your new favorite spot. If you are visiting I'd say skip the hotel front desk fella's recommendation to check out the "local spots" ie restaurants with luxury priced, diner quality food and find your way off the beaten path for a meal you'll actually enjoy.

This was one of my best brunches ever. Me and my girlfriend were nervous at first when we saw the large crowd. But I must say, I was impressed with how fast they got you seated and brought such high quality food so fast. The cappuccino Havana is heaven and the farmers omelet is so good. Must visit again...

Decent. That's the only word I can think of that accurately describes this place. My boyfriend and I had breakfast here after viewing their abundant menu, thinking the food looked unique. We had the hawaiian french toast with berries, and one of their scrambles with biscuits and gravy. Nothing really stood out as being amazing, especially with the poor service. And the coffee was absolutely awful! If you are looking for decent breakfast, this may be your place. But I'm pretty sure there is better in Santa Barbara.

Filthy dirty. We were there at 9 am and it was disgustingly dirty! Then I had to go to the bathroom, BIG mistake!! As I walked in something green dropped from the ceiling and stained my shirt. At first I thought it was bird poop but then I realized it was the air freshener. Then I couldn't turn on the light. I told the lady at the counter that the lights didn't work and she rudely said, "I know"! You should surely take the time to do to the other Starbucks on state st.

Our 10 year old son got in line behind the only customer waiting.  Others lined up and were served before him - despite the fact that they arrived later.  We asked what was going on.  Apparently he should have queued in a different direction.  The "Barista" never said a word.   Terrible service

Andrew is super sweet and his space is incredible! He helped me make a camera strap and put some sturdy reinforcement on it. He also fixed it up free of charge for me really fast when there was a miscommunication about what I wanted. He responds to emails really quickly too. I'll absolutely be going back for all of my custom projects and look forward to taking one of his classes!
Love the red velvet cupcake. Super moist and delicious frosting. Unfortunately the other flavors I tried were super dry. No plans to return.

I like the coffee but I can't go anymore - the brunette gal at the front is not only rude - she's downright hostile and shouldn't be in a customer service.  She's ruining this business; I don't feel comfortable even seeing her.  If you say good morning to her she just looks at you and doesn't respond.  Then you say hi and she just says "what do you want?"  I get it - you don't want me there -  I won't be back.  Other people have mentioned her in the reviews as well.  The other servers are professional & nice, but since  she's always usually there I just need to stay away. She always ruins it for me and I dread going in there.  Who needs it?  Plenty of coffee shops in town.

Luv! Almost don't want to post so I can keep all the gluten-free yummy goodness to myself:). . . The staff was helpful, everything was clean! The food was so yummy! I had the coffee cake muffin and it was delicious! No one would know it was gluten free if you didn't  tell them. For all those who are gluten free and deprived of great baked goods, this is the place! I bake all my gluten free pastries and cakes because most places cannot rid the no gluten hard flaky heavy dense taste that comes with it, so to find a place where I don't have to make it myself is so exciting!
We also enjoyed the Quiche, Cobb Salad, and sandwich. Definitely coming back:)

My favorite coffee shop in SB because of... the coffee! Seriously tasty. They know their beans and have altered my culinary universe. Pastries are delicious as all get out and I'm a bit picky. I don't like that they don't list their pastry prices, nor even a description of what they are, and prices are a bit high, (though that huge chunk of fruit cobbler IS worth $6).
Food is SO GOOD and what an aesthetic! I love that you can convert the breakfast sandwiches to low carb option with lettuce at no extra cost. Fluffy egg is delicious.

I really LOVE the chardonnay lemon raspberry cupcake!!! I've enjoyed their cupcakes from the public market as well as the Los Olivos Sarloos winery.

Service at the public market was friendly and fast.

My nephew wanted a chocolate chip cookie and it was pretty good.

The packaging of 6 cupcakes comes in a cute little egg carton. I ordered 2 separate cupcakes and they just handed them to me, wish they would also come in a small container.

The menu prices on Yelp are completely incorrect.  EG, Eggs Rose, listed here at $10.75 is $15.50.  This seems terribly dishonest to me and potential diners should be forewarned.  The food here is good, but it is far more expensive than Yelp and the restaurant owner have shown.

iced chai with oat milk is a absolute must! I came here because of another review saying this place had the "best breakfast burritos in SB"  and they sure do 10/10 recommend! Their menu has plenty of options with someone for everyone - a coffee shop enthusiast

I'm glad this is something I tried and it was one of the only things open. BUT it did have a weird vibe as someone mentioned before. Their hours are awkward and the person I went with swears one of the cooks was high (not that I mind).
The food tasted great! It was a bit expensive for what you purchase and they were running out of everything. So if you see tape on the menu - don't ask if they have it. 

Overall it was okay.

Super friendly environment. Staff is welcoming and warm and always make sure I'm well taken care of! Not to mention their coffee is delicious and creative! Definitely recommend for anyone who likes trendy coffee shops :)

Ok so if you have read any of my other reviews you know I am a meat-lover. So what am I doing at this vegan restaurant??? I'm loving the food! It's menu is unique, fun, fresh and most importantly super-delish.

I highly recommend the waffle sandwiches. Expect a walk-up to order atmosphere. Sit outside on their wonderful rooftop patio.

Oat Bakery is so convenient with easy walk up window (since covid) and simple street parking.  We currently LOVE all  their gluten free options but have also had their breads with gluten and they are so good!
